The candidate hypothesis introduces numerous highly specific systems and technologies—such as machine learning-driven predictive algorithms, closed-loop microfluidic recirculation systems, real-time multi-sensor arrays, and specific hybrid nanoparticles doped with MAX-phase ceramics—that are not presented, evaluated, or supported in the provided abstract. The study is a comprehensive review paper focusing on existing literature, physicochemical mechanisms, innovative supply equipment, and performance mapping across turning, milling, and grinding, rather than proposing or testing the specific adaptive system detailed in the candidate hypothesis.

VERDICT: REJECT
